newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-FOUR PLAYERS ADDED TO SPRINGBOK SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FOUR PLAYERS ADDED TO SPRINGBOK SQUAD.

text.p: Uncapped loose forward Warren Brosnihan was one of four players added to the Springbok squad on Sunday for the upcoming Tri-Nation series against New Zealand and Australia.
The other three players added to the 21 named on Saturday were flanker Ruben Kruger, lock Mark Andrews and prop forward Marius Hurter.
The team for South Africa's opening match in the tournament against New Zealand on Saturday will be announced on Monday.
Springbok media liaison officer Hermann Coetzee said the selectors had decided not to include an additional backline player until next weekend, following injuries to Japie Mulder and Andre Joubert.
Centre Mulder (shoulder) and full-back Joubert (groin) are both still struggling with injury and have been ruled out of the match against the All Blacks at Ellis Park.

Springbok coach Carel du Plessis named his initial squad of 21 on Saturday, with the one significant change seeing Western Province wing James Small returning from injury to replace his provincial team mate Justin Swart.
Backs: Russell Bennett, Jannie de Beer, Henry Honiball, Percy Montgomery, Pieter Rossouw, Andre Snyman, James Small, Werner Swanepoel, Joost van der Westhuizen, Danie van Schalkwyk.

Forwards: Mark Andrews, Warren Brosnihan, James Dalton, Naka Drotske, Os du Randt, Johan Erasmus, Adrian Garvey, Marius Hurter, Ruben Kruger, Krynauw Otto, Hannes Strydom, Gary Teichmann (captain), Dawie Theron, Fritz van Heerden, Andre Venter.
